item.title: Is the AI bubble bursting? What two earlier crashes can tell us
item.description: AI has crashed twice before, each time because promises outran proof. Using a credit card as the model, here is how both crashes happened, what is different now, and three questions to ask of any AI headline.

item.title: Build your own AI agent harness from scratch in Python
item.description: A coding agent is a model plus a harness: the loop, tools, prompt, safety checks and memory around it. Here is one built from scratch in six small steps, with the code that matters at each layer.
